context: Isolated synthetic business episode; dates/amounts/contracts/people below are case-specific source facts, not new enduring Frostline policy.

records.statement: Tuesday 08:30. Request R-6C: contracted cold store loses all duty and backup cooling; temperature rising, customer reports stock at immediate risk and no adequate workaround. Current covered agreement authorises urgent diagnostic attendance; no guaranteed repair deadline. Request R-6O: prominent office client reports one meeting room uncomfortable and demands immediate response because a director is visiting; remainder operates normally.

Rae is refrigeration-competent and currently authorised, but worked overnight until 05:30 and reports fatigue makes driving/field work unsafe now. No statutory numeric rest period is supplied. Backup Ben is competent, rested, has safe vehicle/equipment, accepted urgent rota mobilisation authority and can reach the cold store at 09:30.

Ben was promised to a planned maintenance appointment this morning. Manager can materially reprioritise with recovery communication. Apprentice Kit is assigned to a two-person installation with senior lead Noor; approved method requires both and direct supervision. Kit is not authorised for independent refrigeration response. Moving Noor alone would invalidate the team method.

unknowns: Customer-confirmed replacement window for displaced maintenance
request: Set the next response plan for two new requests while protecting existing commitments.
